events.name: CLICKED
events.notes: No reward should be inferred from CLICKED

events.name: CLOSED
events.notes: No reward should be inferred from CLOSED

events.name: EARNED_REWARD
events.notes: Preliminary CLIENT-SIDE signal that play-time/unit-end threshold was met; NOT the grant trigger

events.name: REWARD_VERIFIED
events.notes: Fires after SERVER-SIDE verification, includes a rewardToken; this is the correct grant trigger per Simula's own docs

reward_grant_rule: Simula's own React Native SDK docs state explicitly: grant the in-app reward on REWARD_VERIFIED, never on EARNED_REWARD. EARNED_REWARD is a client-side signal that the play-time/unit-end threshold was met but is not proof of a valid, unfaked completion; REWARD_VERIFIED fires only after the SDK's server-side verification call succeeds and carries a rewardToken. Flow: user plays -> EARNED_REWARD (client) -> SDK calls server to verify -> REWARD_VERIFIED (server-confirmed) -> app grants the reward. Native SDK docs (Kotlin/Swift) add: for 'contract 2' video units the reward is anchored at unit_end (the final gate: the primary video's gate, or a rendered fallback end-screen's gate if the primary fails before its own gate) rather than at any earlier click/close event; an explicit verified:false response permanently denies that reward, while a malformed/missing verification response stays retryable.
data_simula_receives: primaryUserID (publisher-supplied, described in docs as a 'hashed user ID for better ad targeting')
SimulaAdContext: search terms, content tags, category, title, description, user profile/email (if the publisher supplies it), custom JSON (e.g. recentCharacters), NSFW flag
Privacy/consent signals: IAB TCF v2.2 consent string, CCPA/USP string, GPP string, GDPR-applicability flag, COPPA child-directed flag, advertising-ID opt-in
Device/connection data per simula.ad privacy policy: advertising identifier (IDFA/GAID where permitted), IP address, device type/model, OS+version, language, time zone, mobile carrier, network type
Standard server log data: browser type, OS, referring URLs, pages visited
General location inferred from IP (country/region only, not precise GPS)

Publisher metadata: up to 10 string key/value pairs attached per ad load/impression (keys <=64 unicode code points, no '$' prefix or '.', values <=256 code points); explicitly NOT for PII, credentials, tokens or secrets (Kotlin README)

Simula privacy policy states it does NOT receive publisher-app chat/conversation content, including messages exchanged with AI characters, and does not knowingly process sensitive personal info (health, financial, biometric)
trigger_constraints: Reward must be granted on REWARD_VERIFIED (server-confirmed), not on EARNED_REWARD (client-only) or on CLICKED/CLOSED

For rewarded video 'contract 2' units, reward authority sits at unit_end (the final gate reached), not at an earlier event; an admitted primary video that fails before its own gate can still earn if a rendered fallback end-screen reaches its gate
verified:false from the server permanently reconciles (denies) that reward; a malformed/absent verification response remains retryable rather than treated as a denial
Publisher metadata is capped at 10 entries per ad load and must exclude PII/secrets

Staging/dev backend selection requires an explicit host-app manifest/plist flag (SimulaStagingEnvironmentEnabled) AND an exact X.Y.Z-dev.N build; stable SDK builds refuse staging and fail closed to production
First valid API key + environment 'own' the native SDK for the process lifetime; switching either requires a cold app restart (INITIALIZATION_CONFLICT otherwise)
